steps.content:
<color=#7683a2>Netizen A</color>: Have you heard about the <color=#fb9259>Future Charity Foundation</color> case? It's about the FAC scandal from 10 years ago. It's a big deal.

<color=#7683a2>Netizen B</color>: I did! Wow, 1 billion DisCoins, that's huge. I'm not a family member and even I'm furious. Huh, pretending to be so innocent, there must be a whistleblower in FAC.

<color=#7683a2>Netizen A</color>: Speaking of which, the <color=#fb9259>Eastside Hotel Massacre</color>... It seems like someone silenced all the people involved, all the core members of the Charity Foundation were wiped out. Amazing, what a hero!

<color=#7683a2>Netizen B</color>: Heard it was a beautiful assassin from the Garden? Punishing evil and promoting good, brilliant!
<color=#fb9259>Anonymous</color>: No, didn't you hear? There's one more person who didn't die, the real mastermind behind the Foundation... Eugean!
<color=#fb9259>Anonymous</color>: He didn't go to the Eastside Hotel at all. His signature wasn't among the guests at that banquet.

<color=#fb9259>Insider Scoop</color>: Yes, I have a mole within the criminal investigation team who told me there was a murder at the hotel, at the Future Charity Foundation to be exact, even before all this. Only one victim—Eugean.

<color=#fb9259>Insider Scoop</color>: But do you know? <size=50>Eugean isn't dead!</size> He was saved!! 


<color=#fb9259>Insider Scoop</color>: I have <color=#fb9259>photos</color>, straight from the criminal investigation team's database!

<color=#7683a2>Netizen A</color>: Impossible! He was the source of all the scandals, he set up this entire charade, took the most money, and in the end, he's the only one left alive? Where's the justice in that??

<color=#7683a2>Netizen B</color>: How could the Garden have failed? Aren't they the most ruthless and brutal assassins?
<color=#fb9259>Insider Scoop</color>: Heh, a few assassins are no match for the bigwigs of the Charity Foundation. They were fooled...

21:25, August 14th, N.F. 113
Eastside Third Avenue, 
Future Charity Foundation Sanatorium

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Inspector!! We demand an explanation! Is it true that Eugean is still alive? What are you trying to achieve by keeping this a secret?

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Could it be that there were never any assassins from the Garden? This is all Eugean's own doing! When he heard someone was clearing up the scandal from back then, he faked his own death, didn't he!

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Give us an explanation! The attention is getting higher, you can't hide this! We saw him in person at the sanatorium!!

Reporters who caught wind of the story have completely blocked the front door of the Future Charity Foundation Sanatorium. They all hold so-called "reliable information" in their hands, clamoring for Eugean, the Charity Foundation head who's clinging to life, to come out and confess. The scene is abuzz with noise all at once.
On the other side of the crowd, a slender figure stands for a while before turning to leave.
She cleverly conceals her face, moving quietly without drawing attention, but her pace quickens, finally darting into a dark alley, running, filled with surging hatred.

steps.speaker: Hidden Figure
steps.content: ...It's my mistake, I need to clean up this mess. Even if I am driven out, I can't cause any more trouble for Mentor...

steps.speaker: Hidden Figure
steps.content: Bastard... Bastard!! I clearly stabbed him! I used my ability, I made sure!!

steps.speaker: Hidden Figure
steps.content: If that scumbag can live, why can't the people he killed!

She made sure that the man was in the top-secret ward in the northeast corner, who had just been urgently transferred there three days ago. She couldn't possibly mistake the man in the photo, it was the bastard who ruined her life.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: I'll kill you, I'll kill you over and over again! I'll kill you with my own hands!!
She turns into a side door hidden in the shadows where someone has been waiting for her.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...You really did come. Has your confinement been lifted?

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Why are you here?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I didn't expect it to be you either... We sure are fated.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Shalom was right, a rookie assassin who is so stubborn that she would act without the permission of the Mentor, and a junior who needs her Mentor to clean up after her, would absolutely not tolerate failing a second time.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You're too eager to put someone to death, that's why you fell for this trap.
The assassin's voice begins to tremble, her eyes reddening.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: I should have killed you back then!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Stop committing atrocities in the name of vengeance! Now, I am arresting you for the attempted murder of Eugean. Surrender and confess! This is your last chance!
